scene_brief: Airport baggage claim. He looks grandly back toward Buddy. Only a human lower arm reaching from far left toward Neet suggests Heather approaching, appearance provisional, no face. Camera slightly elevated threequarter so carousel edge, floor and paws clearly distinct, no dog embedded in belt.
